current_answer: Choose by the job. If you have a reference screenshot to reproduce, use existing project components and tokens, render at the image width, and compare regions before calling it matched. UXKIN ui-from-screenshot describes that workflow; its source is mutable and we have not tested its output. If visual direction is open, use a direction-oriented skill or a brief instead. A Figma-value checker is a separate verification route, not proof a design skill improves results.

catalogue_card.question: Need to match a supplied screenshot?
catalogue_card.text: Use a reference-matching workflow, not a skill that invents a new style. UXKIN ui-from-screenshot says to reuse project components and compare the render at the image width. We read its mutable instructions but have not tested the result.
